title: Any Incremental game enjoyers? Would love some feedback for my Upcoming game!
author: Gold_Move6034
selftext:
Hey guys!  
For the past 2 weeks I've been working on my first ever Incremental Game.   
Game loop is - You chop some trees the run ends and you upgrade your skill tree, and start the run again. 

If you are interested in these type of Incremental games, you can try it out:

[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5112800/Dont_Stop_Cutting_The_Trees/?utm_source=steam)

[Itchio](https://duskpacket.itch.io/dont-stop-cutting-the-trees) \- Browser Version of the game, no download needed.

Would love to have some feedback on:

Does the game pacing feels good?

Anything that feels this game lacks?

comments.author: RecordingTechnical86
comments.body: Good that the Art Style is consistent

comments.author: Segaiai
comments.body: Before I give feedback, what do you feel makes both the active game play, and the game loop as a whole, engaging? I'm currently confused about the approach to game design. Having a hard time imagining the kind of player you're aiming for. I see strong elements for two different kinds of gameplay loops, but having a hard time seeing how they fit together in a satisfying way for a single approach.

replies.author: Gold_Move6034
replies.body: Well, this is an Incremental Game, so part of the fun is progression aspect of it? You are progressing further down the Map while Upgrading your Skill Tree, and you feel the progression as you move through the map while chopping the trees, to get to a new map you have to chop down the "Boss Tree" to unlock a new map. I'm aiming specifically for Players who enjoy Incremental Games.

replies.author: EC36339
replies.body: It's an incremental game. It's like a game with a lot of mindless grind, but without all the other stuff.

comments.author: SimCFB
comments.body: That walk animation would drive me insane. Just my 2 cents. Best of luck, looks pretty fun otherwise.

replies.author: Gold_Move6034
replies.body:
Yeah it does look goofy I guess, but it has it's own charm. There could be some improvements of course.  
Can you explain more why would it drive you insane, I don't quite understand the frustration with that.

replies.author: Fuzzzy420
replies.body:
It's annoying. 
You expect the character to move to the right, but it doesn't really. 
Just animate the character properly

replies.author: SimCFB
replies.body: Just looks low quality. That's the best answer I can give you. There are much neater ways to animate that.

comments.author: No-Departure-7605
comments.body: Hi, as many people Said, the Animation of Walking Looks Bad but the Overall Look is nice! Sincerly
